alex: Planning dedicated rollout for Windfall Corp. Proposed quiet window: 2026-07-02 01:30-03:30 UTC. Need ops + security + product thumbs.
maria: @alex product ok with the release notes. Small behavioral tweak to tokenization, see notes. I can be on call until 02:45 UTC.
elaine: Model pinned: windfall/dedicated:v2026-07-02-quant-1. Pin verified against canary. Added short release blurb in the notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/1427
jamal: SRE here. KMS keys ok. I'll provision an extra GPU slice for priming and set a traffic throttle for first 20m. Rollback threshold: 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m OR 95th latency > 350ms for 5m.
jamal: Runbook snippet added: ```
- pre-prime KV cache 20m before window
- smoke test: /generate?prompt=hello -> 200 and tokens < 300ms avg
- if threshold hit -> trigger rollback: `deployctl rollback --target windfall --to v2026-06-28-stable`
- notify #incidents and paging SRE
```
deploybot: Deploy scheduled job_id=wf-8217 scheduled_by=alex target=windfall/dedicated window=2026-07-02T01:30:00Z-2026-07-02T03:30:00Z pinned_version=v2026-07-02-quant-1
sre-oncall: Confirmed provisioning. I'll prime KV cache at 01:10 UTC and run pre-smoke at 01:20. Setting up dashboards and alert burns.
alex: One ask from ops: can we delay priming by 10m to align with tenant traffic freeze? Otherwise LGTM.
jamal: Delay OK. I'll shift priming to 01:20 and smoke at 01:30.
maria: Noted. Product approves the slightly later prime. :thumbsup:
elaine: Security: no additional controls required. Audit logs will capture deploybot actions.
alex: Final call - any objections to proceeding as scheduled?
maria: :white_check_mark: approve
jamal: approve from SRE. Ready to roll and rollback if needed.
sre-oncall: I'll be live on pager for the window.
deploybot: job wf-8217 queued. Logs: `deployctl logs --job wf-8217`. Start ETA 2026-07-02T01:30:00Z.
